title: CI: burst-anchored baseline prober for PR perf gating
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description: Introduce a CI harness that anchors PR performance checks to a rolling burst-aware baseline. The harness captures microburst behaviour and tokens/sec p95 under representative batching/sequence-length mixes, applies an uncertainty-aware statistical gate, and returns deterministic pass/fail signals for PRs. The goal is to reduce false positives from noisy bursts while still catching meaningful regressions in serving throughput and tail latency.
acceptance_criteria: 1) CI prober runs deterministically in PRs within allocated runner time (max 20m) and produces a summary artifact with tokens/sec p50/p95/p99 and sample variance.
2) Baseline selection: harness computes an adaptive baseline from the last 30 successful CI runs with recency weighting and persists a compact baseline fingerprint in S3 for traceability.

3) Gate logic: PR fails if p95 tokens/sec drops by >=5% relative to baseline and the observed drop passes a nonparametric significance test (bootstrap p <= 0.01) after accounting for baseline variance.
4) Microburst detection: harness reports burst score and flags if regression only appears in <1% of windows to avoid gating on transient noise; such cases go into review queue instead of auto-fail.
5) All artifacts (raw traces, numeric summaries, runner logs) are uploaded and linked in the PR check output for triage.
6) Integration tests: run against three model sizes (small/medium/large) and two sequence distributions (webchat, long-doc) to validate cross-slice stability.
implementation_notes: Design: runner container uses the existing perf-harness image with lightweight workload generator (token-emitter) and deterministic seeds.
Metric collection: emit tokens/sec at 1s resolution, record per-request latency histogram; attach host-level GPU metrics via node exporter for correlation.
Baseline algorithm: compute weighted rolling median and bootstrap CI using 1k resamples; weight = exp(-alpha * age) where alpha tuned on historical runs.
Stat test: prefer nonparametric bootstrap over z-tests due to heavy-tailed latency distributions; verify false positive rate on historic baseline dataset.
Storage: baseline fingerprint stored as S3 JSON blob and referenced by commit hash; CI reads latest successful baseline for same model/config.
Gating flow: if deterministic fail -> block merge; if ambiguous (low power or burst-only) -> annotate PR with triage label and link to perf dashboard.
Rollout plan: enable for core runtime repo initially, run for 2 weeks in advisory mode then enable auto-fail for P0-only PRs.

notes: Trade-offs considered: tighter gates reduce risk of regressions but increase developer friction; we intentionally bias towards lower false positives for microburst-only failures.
Future: consider combining this with adaptive request shaping and short-lived canary deployments to observe real-traffic behaviour before merge.
If baseline drift is detected systemically, schedule a rebaselining window and notify owners with suggested rollback commits.
Owners: Ayesha (PM) and Miguel (ENG) to coordinate threshold tuning and rollout cadence.
